inputs.text: This case shows the rot that takes hold when those in power cast aside personal responsibility and the authority entrusted to them. Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who chaired the Technical Evaluation Committee, stood at the center of this improper land purchase for a cemetery at Ksh.283 million, even though the site was unsuitable. The court rightly ordered the full amount recovered from her. Such misconduct by officials erodes the social order, squanders resources meant to serve families and communities, and weakens the cultural continuity that keeps society stable. We need leaders who uphold duty, accountability, and respect for tradition instead of schemes that betray the public trust.

output.main_topic: Improper cemetery land purchase and accountability for public funds
